conviction_note: J-REIT print with a managed DPU (a 660m yen retention buffer, and every guide raised so far), three small post-guide acquisitions the company itself calls 'immaterial', and an interest-rate headwind already in the sector tape. The findings net to about zero; abs_move stays near the 0.83% proxy (0.9, nudged up because a first 43期 guide comes with this release); p_up is 48 because the last three prints traded flat to slightly below the REIT ETF (excess -0.17/-0.34/-0.30) and 信用倍率 is 41x.
bar: Company forecast 41期 (Aug-2026) DPU 2,397 yen and 42期 (Feb-2027) DPU 2,384 yen, from the 2026-04-16 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260416/140120260410502075.pdf. No 四季報/IFIS figure reachable, so the company plan is the only sourced bar and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-19: 0.0% disclosed (no holder at or above 0.5%), change 0.0 pts (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 41.0, a crowded margin long. No option skew exists. priced_lean_pct -0.50 (margin overhang -0.81, run-up +0.31). The 20-day run-up of -6.19% is sector beta: the REIT ETF 1343.T fell from 1,909.5 to 1,791 over the same 20 sessions (Yahoo chart).

findings.finding: 41期 monthly occupancy averaged 97.23% (Mar 98.0, Apr 97.1, May 97.1, Jun 97.2, Jul 97.1, Aug 96.9) against the forecast assumption of 97.5%, and September 2026 read 97.2% against the 97.6% assumed for 42期. That is about 0.1-0.2 pts below the same months a year earlier: management is pushing turnover rents (+15.6%) at some cost to occupancy.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Occupancy beat its assumption by 0.1 pt in 40期 (97.6 vs 97.5) and DPU beat by 34 yen; the stock still fell 1.04% the next day (REIT ETF -0.74%). The occupancy line has not visibly moved this name.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (updated with the 2026-08-31 figures); September figure at https://www.naf-r.jp/portfolio/5-3_42.html
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the series is public monthly on the IR site. The shortfall is about 35m yen of revenue, roughly 14 yen of 2,397 DPU, and a 660m yen retention buffer can absorb it, so the reported DPU is unlikely to show it. It survives only as a hint that the 42期 occupancy assumption (97.6%) may be trimmed.
findings.independence: The 40期 presentation's assumption table (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260416/140120260415504941.pdf) is the bar side of the same comparison, not independent evidence.

findings.finding: Three properties bought after the April guide, all debt-funded and none in the 42期 forecast: Park Cube Hachioji 1.62bn yen (6/5), Park Cube Omori Sanno 3.13bn (9/1) and Park Cube Nakano North 1.61bn (10/1), 6.36bn yen in total. Each notice says the effect is 軽微 and the forecast is unchanged. Separately, every recent DPU guide has been raised by the print: 39期 2,234 to 2,324 actual, 40期 2,346 to 2,371 to 2,405, and 41期 from 2,335 initial to 2,397.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-10-20 print (39期 beat of about 4%, 41期 first guide 2,335) closed -0.15% the next day against an ETF +0.02%. The 2026-04-16 print (40期 beat of +34 yen) closed -1.04% against an ETF -0.74%. Raised guides have not been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The acquisitions were disclosed on TDnet with the 'no forecast change' language, and the record of raised guides is in kabutan's headlines. What is unpriced is only the size of the 42期 bump, roughly 15-20 yen from the acquisitions (6.36bn at a 3.5-3.9% cap rate, less about 1.5% funding cost), and that sits inside the normal beat range.
findings.independence: The kabutan headline record of upward DPU changes (https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/3226/news/k202510200002/ and https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/3226/news/k202604160004/) is a different source for the raise pattern.

findings.finding: Funding costs are a drag on the 43期 first guide. The BOJ raised its rate to 1.0% on 2026-06-16, after the April guide. 13.0bn yen of long debt matures in 42期 and 14.0bn in 43期 (the 41期 maturities averaged 0.25% and were refinanced at 1.43%), new loans are TIBOR-floating, and management said in April that it will retain sale gains rather than distribute them because borrowing costs are rising fast. A 43期 initial DPU at or below 2,384 would miss the stated EPU growth target of 2-3% a year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-04-16 print carried a first 42期 guide below 41期 (2,384 vs 2,397) and closed -1.04% the next day, -0.30% excess over the REIT ETF.
findings.source_date: 2026-04 (40期 決算説明会 Q&A); maturity ladder in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260416/140120260415504941.pdf (2026-04-16); BOJ hike per https://media.monex.co.jp/articles/-/30278 (snippet_only)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the sector is down about 6% in 20 sessions on rates, and this name tracks it one for one. What is not public is the size of the 43期 guide itself. Kabutan's retail headline is written off the first-guide 経常 change, so a guide showing a profit decline gets a negative headline into a register that is 41x margin long.
findings.independence: Floating TIBOR pricing on the August-October 2026 borrowings (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260929/140120260929542228.pdf) confirms the rate exposure; it is a different document.

searched_and_found_nothing: Event confirmed: the IR calendar https://www.naf-r.jp/ir/7-3.html lists 決算発表日 2026-10-20 and an analyst call on 2026-10-21.

No 業績予想の修正 or 分配金予想の修正 filed for 41期/42期 since 2026-04-16 (kabutan disclosure list https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3226, all pages back to 2025-12). The 40期 Dec-2025 mid-period revision has no counterpart this period.

Capital return: no 自己投資口 has ever been held (期末自己投資口数 －). The April Q&A says sale gains go to retained earnings to fund acquisitions, so a buyback is not signalled. This is the strongest positive I looked for and found absent.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: 42期 DPU 2,384 likely nudged up by +10-30 yen from acquisitions and rent growth, offset by rates; no pre-release filed. Returns: none expected, since management is retaining gains. New guide: a first 43期 (Aug-2027) DPU, the main item; refinancing drag against a 2-3% EPU growth target. rejected_candidates.candidate: Run-up of -6.19% over 20 days as a name-specific signal
rejected_candidates.detail: The REIT ETF 1343.T fell the same 6.2% over the same window, so the run-up is sector beta and not information about this print.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the mildly negative priced lean (crowded 41x margin long) but net to roughly zero. The strongest positive (a raised 42期 guide, a 41期 beat) is likely to arrive, and it was not bought the last two times. A buyback is the other positive, and I looked for it and found it explicitly disclaimed.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative that rests on a public monthly series): the occupancy finding is cut from -0.1 to -0.05, and p_up moved from 47 toward 50, to 48.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): I checked the strongest positive (a raised guide, a buyback) and documented it in baseline_tension. The rate-headwind negative is trimmed from -0.2 to -0.15 because the sector tape already carries the rate move.
Net: impact_sum goes from -0.10 to 0.00 and expected_move from -0.05 to -0.04.
